TechStack: Python, LangChain, FAISS, Flask        Role: FullStack                                                                           
• Developed a RAG-based travel chatbot using LangChain, Hugging Face embeddings, and FAISS to retrieve relevant information from custom 
travel documents. 
• Integrated an LLM to generate context-aware answers based on retrieved hotel, transportation, destination, and trip-planning data. 
• Built and deployed the chatbot interface using Flask, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript with persistent FAISS vector storage. 
• Implemented document processing and text chunking to convert travel documents into searchable knowledge for efficient information retrieval. 
• Designed the retrieval pipeline to provide relevant context to the LLM, improving the accuracy and relevance of chatbot responses. 
 
CONTRACT AI – AI Powered Contract Risk Analysis Platform                                                           Duration: Aug26-ongoing                 
TechStack: Python, FastAPI, SQLite, SQLAlchemy, ML/NLP, REST APIs, ReportLab   Role:Backend 
• Developed an AI-powered contract analysis system to automatically extract contract information, detect clauses, identify risks, and classify 
contract types. 
• Built a modular FastAPI backend with dedicated routers and services for clause detection, risk scoring, recommendations, renewal analysis, 
compliance checks, and contract summarization.  
• Implemented rule-based playbook compliance to evaluate contracts against company policies, including notice periods, prohibited terms, 
governing laws, cure periods, and liability limits. 
• Generated downloadable PDF reports and automated renewal alerts with SMTP-based email notifications to help users track contract risks and 
deadlines.
